scope: Exploratory acquisition and parsing only. No final-test evaluation or route generation.
selection: Read only trip metadata to choose the lowest numeric trip IDs: up to 10 declared cars and 10 declared buses. Inventory all other mode labels and quarantine them. All selected trips are development; unselected trips are outside this probe, not a reserved test set.
ordering: Point ID ascending within each trip, then check timestamps. Do not sort away a clock reversal, interpolate gaps, or relabel mode from speed.
timestamp_timezone: UTC-03:00, following the UCI dataset documentation; convert explicitly to UTC.
timestamped_trip_usable: Declared car/bus, at least two points, finite in-range latitude/longitude, parseable timestamps, strictly increasing time and positive duration. This is parser usability, not vehicle-type validation or suitability for off-road evaluation.
gap_rule: Intervals above this are marked unobserved for motion classification. Report their duration and endpoint chord separately. The one-minute ceiling defines observation granularity for this diagnostic, not a proven GPS sampling requirement. Trips with gaps remain timestamped but are excluded from continuous timing examples.
distance: Sum adjacent-point spherical great-circle chords, with gap chords reported separately. No map matching or route reconstruction. Coordinate datum is undocumented; WGS84-like latitude/longitude is an explicit provisional assumption. Chord distance can undercount turns and GPS jitter can overcount distance.
stop_rule: Consecutive observed intervals below the speed threshold lasting at least the minimum duration are low-motion estimates. Gaps interrupt runs. This suppresses brief jitter but does not establish physical stops. Stop-adjusted elapsed equals elapsed minus estimated low-motion time, and is not validated moving time.
speed_rule: Flag an observed interval above this broad consistency screen for inspection. Never infer mode from it or silently delete it. No road speed limit or passability inference.
baseline_rule: An uncalibrated constant-speed arithmetic example only: time = observed chord distance / speed; residual = stop-adjusted elapsed minus that time. No fitting, pass threshold or generalization claim.
privacy: Raw traces, trip/device IDs, exact dates, coordinates, endpoints and per-trip metrics stay local outside git. Public output is corpus-level counts and pooled summaries only, without per-trip examples. No maps rendered.
final_test: None. Future evaluation must freeze trip/corridor and season groups before evaluation, including device/repeated-route dependence. Existing detector holdouts remain unopened.
